note: Maps the existing free attribute fields (element.a.<field>) to ONE normalized relation vocabulary. Semantics were read from sampled elements; basis 'confirmed' = seen on sampled pairs, 'assumed' = the field itself is a guess. Directions are subject(element holding the field) -> object(referenced id). IFC4.3 analogues in 'ifc'.

hosted_by.meaning: subject sits in/on an object host (wall, ceiling, slab, floor)

supported_by.meaning: subject is held by a support detail (bracket, clip, rod)

connects.meaning: link element runs from one element to another; stored once per link with from/to; a link may be open at one end (wire_homerun_open, wire_circuit_end) -> the missing end is null and open=from|to

serves.meaning: subject delivers to / is fed by the object

member_of_source_group.meaning: subject was drawn from a group of source elements

level_reference.meaning: subject takes its level/height from the object

sleeve_of.meaning: subject is the sleeve around the object conductor

extends.meaning: subject extends an existing element (e.g. lift-head wall extends the wall below)

joins.meaning: two pipe paths touch end-to-end (ports within 0.2 cm, same system family); derived by pipeline/ports.py, never across systems

branches_from.meaning: the end of a pipe lies on the interior of another path of the same system (a tee is needed); derived by pipeline/ports.py

inserted_in.meaning: a generated component sits inside a run (its carrier pipe); the run's axis is untouched, so the component overlays it

part_of_assembly.meaning: element belongs to an assembly generated from a drawing sample; object is an assembly id (assemblies[] in the model)

assembled_on.meaning: assembly (subject, an assembly id) was applied to a host element (object) following a sample

member_of_system.meaning: element carries a.sys; object is a system node (tables.systems)

in_space.meaning: element carries a.room; object is a space node keyed by (level,label) (tables.spaces); labels are raw drawing labels, not verified room identities

bridges.meaning: a generated valve sits between two runs of DIFFERENT systems (e.g. FCU return<->supply NC valve) without joining them

drains_to.meaning: a generated condensate run discharges into this floor trap

sleeve_id.note: subject holds the sleeve id; relation is sleeve(subject=sleeve) -> conductor
